text:
harper: small design sync 7: mini-sitemap + crumb-compression idea for console nav. instead of fully expanding leftnav for deep links, we surface a compact breadcrumb + a contextual mini-sitemap drawer. want quick takes on URL shape + a11y.
jules: sounds interesting. URL-wise? keep canonical path stable and add `?mini=metrics` or `?crumb=metrics`?
harper: proposal: stable resource path + `?compact_view=metrics#slot` so shares still land on the resource but reveal the mini-sitemap pane and jump to slot. e.g. `/console/pipelines/tx9?compact_view=metrics#p50`.
kai: a11y: when mini-sitemap opens it must be announced and receive focus. use `role=region aria-labelledby` and `aria-live=polite` to announce "Metrics panel opened". stash origin element id so ESC restores focus.
marta: perf note: don't render the entire leftnav. lazy-mount mini-sitemap when `compact_view` present and prioritize its data fetch. show `aria-busy=true` skeleton until it's ready.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) programmatic focus to heading 2) SR announcement 3) visible focus ring after JS focus 4) ESC returns focus 5) respects prefers-reduced-motion for highlight.
router-bot: route-scan: pattern `/console/*/:id` + `compact_view` param overlaps with sidecar handlers. recommend central `applyCompactView(params)` util to avoid collisions.
jules: history/back behaviour: initial reveal should use `history.replaceState` to avoid noisy back entries; if user navigates inside the mini-sitemap (clicks another tab) then `pushState`. sample: `const u = new URL(location); u.searchParams.set('compact_view','metrics'); history.replaceState(null,'',u);`.
harper: crumb UX: append compressed crumb ` / Metrics` when open; clicking it collapses mini-sitemap and `history.replaceState` removes param. crumb should be keyboard-focusable and have `aria-label='Close metrics mini sitemap'`.
kai: when focusing into the mini-sitemap, ensure the target anchor gets a temporary `tabindex='-1'`, `focus({preventScroll:true})`, then `scrollIntoView({behavior:'auto'})` once rendered. avoid unexpected scroll jumps.
marta: shared-link highlight: support `?highlight=p50` that briefly pulses the element (2s) and adds `aria-describedby='share-note'` with text "Highlighted by link". fade for reduced-motion users. check color contrast.
jules: analytics: emit `ui.compact_view_open` with {path, view, anchor, via_deeplink:true, expanded_session_only:true}. capture focus-restore success flag.
a11y-bot: auto-note: add automated SR smoke test for "Metrics panel opened" narration and keyboard-only flow.
harper: edgecases: resource not loaded -> queue the open until fetch done. implement a small `deferredOpen` keyed by route. normalize URLs (strip trailing slash, lowercase id) to reduce duplicates.
kai: also guard against focusable elements not present: if anchor missing, focus panel heading and optionally show inline message "Item not found" and fire `nav.compact_view_missing`.
marta: QA: keyboard-only test, SR narration, focus-visible after programmatic focus, contrast check on highlight, history/back test.
harper: feature-flag it: `console.compact_mini_sitemap`. i'll draft the pattern doc with canonical examples, focus utils, replace vs push rules, deferred queue sketch, analytics schema, and the accessibility checklist. will open PR in a bit 
jules: will review router interactions.
kai: i'll do accessibility review.
marta: perf + lazy-hydration review from infra.
a11y-bot: scheduled note: run accessibility smoke once PR merged.
harper: thanks all :sparkles:
